description: This file defines the WorkflowStateModel class within the OrangeHRM system, implementing serialization of workflow state data for an API. It encapsulates a WorkflowStateMachine entity and provides a method to convert its data into an array for API responses.

classes.name: WorkflowStateModel
classes.description: Represents a model for workflow states used in API serialization within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a WorkflowStateMachine entity.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the workflow state data into an associative array for API responses.
